content: Completed backend/frontend message audit (Aug 18, 2026). Backend: Fixed 8 custom exception default messages (grammar, spelling, professionalism), fixed 5 inconsistent handler success messages. Frontend: Updated 31 catch blocks from `catch {}` to `catch (err)` with `err?.response?.data?.message || err?.message || 'fallback'` pattern. Replaced 8 redundant hardcoded `toast.success()` calls with `showSuccessToast: true` flag to use backend messages. Both frontend and backend build cleanly (0 errors).
